Summary: Initialize Smart Customer Service Assistant repository and developer tooling
Description: Create app skeleton: FastAPI backend, React frontend, docker-compose with postgres+redis, ruff/black/mypy, pytest, .env.example, Makefile, CI workflow stub.
Business Value: Foundation for all subsequent tickets.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. docker-compose up starts all services. 2. pytest exits 0. 3. ruff and mypy pass. 4. README has exact setup steps.
Technical Notes: Python 3.11+. FastAPI. PostgreSQL. React + TypeScript + Vite. pgvector for knowledge base.
Testing Requirements: Smoke: app imports without error. Docker: all services healthy.
Security Requirements: .env not committed. .env.example present.
Definition of Done: All AC met. CI green. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Document system architecture and key technical decisions
Description: Write ARCHITECTURE.md: chat API → conversation manager → ticket classifier → RAG retriever → response generator → escalation detector → agent queue or customer response. Include ADRs for RAG choice, escalation strategy, conversation state design.
Business Value: Shared mental model prevents design drift.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. ARCHITECTURE.md covers full support flow. 2. At least 2 ADRs in docs/architecture/. 3. Escalation logic documented. 4. Conversation state design documented.
Technical Notes: Document conversation state schema in Redis. Document how RAG knowledge base is loaded and refreshed.
Testing Requirements: Docs review: architecture matches implementation.
Security Requirements: None specific.
Definition of Done: ARCHITECTURE.md complete. ADRs stored. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Create core database schema and migration workflow
Description: Model and migrate: customers, conversations, messages, ticket_classifications, knowledge_articles (with pgvector), escalation_events, agent_assignments, feedback. Indexes on conversation status and customer_id.
Business Value: Correct schema prevents data model re-work.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. alembic upgrade head runs clean. 2. downgrade -1 rolls back. 3. knowledge_articles has vector(1536) with HNSW index. 4. All tables have timestamps.
Technical Notes: knowledge_articles.embedding: vector(1536) with HNSW index. conversation.status: open/active/escalated/resolved.
Testing Requirements: Integration: migrate on test DB, verify schema.
Security Requirements: DB credentials in env vars only.
Definition of Done: Migrations run and roll back. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Implement versioned API foundation and error contract
Description: Implement: POST /v1/conversations; POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages; GET /v1/conversations/{id}; POST /v1/conversations/{id}/escalate; POST /v1/feedback; GET /v1/analytics/summary; GET /v1/health; GET /v1/ready.
Business Value: Stable API for chat UI and agent dashboard.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. All endpoints correct status codes. 2. Error envelope matches portfolio spec. 3. /health 200. 4. Request IDs in all responses.
Technical Notes: See docs/api/api-style-guide.md. X-Request-ID middleware. SSE endpoint for streaming responses.
Testing Requirements: API tests: every endpoint, valid/invalid input, error envelope.
Security Requirements: Auth stub only — full auth in P03-05.
Definition of Done: All endpoints tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Implement authentication authorization and configuration security
Description: JWT auth for agents. Anonymous session token for customers (chat widget). Conversation isolation: customers only see their own conversations. Agents see only their assigned queue. Config validation at startup.
Business Value: Security for multi-role support system.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Unauth → 401. 2. Customer A cannot access Customer B's conversation → 403. 3. Agent sees only assigned queue. 4. Missing env vars → startup failure.
Technical Notes: Two auth paths: JWT for agents
AI-SDLC Phase: anonymous session token (Redis TTL 24h) for customers. customer_id from token context only.
Testing Requirements: SECURE
Security Requirements: Security tests: 401, 403, customer isolation.
Definition of Done: No tokens in logs. Session tokens in env var-backed Redis.

Summary: Conversation session management
Description: Implement: create conversation (assigns session ID), add message to conversation, get conversation with message history, resolve conversation. Persist conversation state in PostgreSQL. Load recent messages for context assembly.
Business Value: Core data management that all AI features depend on.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Conversation created with session ID. 2. Messages stored in order. 3. Last 10 messages returned for context. 4. Resolved conversation cannot receive new messages. 5. Tests cover all state transitions.
Technical Notes: Conversation state: open→active→escalated→resolved. Store messages with role (customer/assistant/agent). Index on conversation_id+created_at.
Testing Requirements: Unit: state transitions. Integration: full message flow.
Security Requirements: customer_id from auth context only.
Definition of Done: Conversation lifecycle tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Ticket classification and routing
Description: Implement classifier: LLM zero-shot classification of customer message into intent categories (billing, technical, account, general). Store classification with confidence score. Use classification to route to appropriate knowledge base sections.
Business Value: Classification improves retrieval relevance and escalation accuracy.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Classifier produces intent + confidence for test messages. 2. Classification stored in DB. 3. Low-confidence (<0.5) defaults to 'general'. 4. Unit test with mocked LLM: 5 intent categories.
Technical Notes: Output: { intent: string, confidence: float }. Validate with Pydantic. Categories: billing, technical, account, general, complaint. See .kiro/specs/project-03/spec.md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: classifier with mocked LLM. Integration: message → classification stored.
Security Requirements: LLM API key in env var. No message content in structured logs.
Definition of Done: Classifier tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: RAG knowledge base integration
Description: Implement knowledge base retrieval: hybrid search (BM25 + pgvector) on knowledge_articles. Filter by article category matching ticket intent. Return top-3 articles with snippets. Ingest knowledge articles via admin API.
Business Value: RAG grounding is what prevents hallucinated support responses.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Retrieval returns relevant articles for test queries. 2. Category filter applied based on intent. 3. Admin API ingests articles with embedding generation. 4. Workspace isolation enforced. 5. Unit test for retrieval with fixtures.
Technical Notes: Hybrid search: RRF fusion of BM25 and pgvector cosine. Max 3 articles, max 500 tokens per article. Admin API: POST /v1/admin/articles. See .kiro/specs/project-03/spec.md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: retrieval with mocked embeddings. Integration: ingest → search pipeline.
Security Requirements: Knowledge articles are customer-specific — tenant isolation enforced.
Definition of Done: RAG retrieval tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Response generation with tone and context
Description: Implement response generator: LLM with conversation history + retrieved articles. System prompt enforces: helpful tone, cite article sources, acknowledge uncertainty. Output includes draft response and source references. Agents can edit before sending.
Business Value: Grounded response generation is the core support AI capability.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Generated response references relevant knowledge article. 2. Response stored with source citations. 3. Agent can edit draft before sending. 4. Unit test with mocked LLM. 5. Prompt injection test: adversarial input does not hijack system prompt.
Technical Notes: System prompt: role = support assistant, answer from context only, cite articles, tone = professional and empathetic. See .kiro/specs/project-03/spec.md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: generator with mocked LLM. Security: prompt injection via customer message.
Security Requirements: LLM API key in env var. Customer messages in parameterized slot only.
Definition of Done: Response generation tested including prompt injection. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Escalation detection and handoff
Description: Implement escalation detector: rule-based (explicit request) + LLM-based (anger, unresolved after 3 turns). On escalation: mark conversation as escalated, add to agent queue, notify agent (stub). Test escalation accuracy.
Business Value: Escalation to human agents is critical for customer satisfaction and liability.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Explicit escalation request triggers escalation. 2. Anger signal detected and escalation triggered. 3. Unresolved after 3 turns triggers escalation. 4. Escalated conversation appears in agent queue. 5. Accuracy tested against 10 test cases.
Technical Notes: Escalation signals: explicit (I want to speak to a human), sentiment (anger detected), loop (3+ turns without resolution). LLM escalation check: output { should_escalate: bool, reason: string }.
Testing Requirements: Unit: escalation detector (rule-based and LLM). Integration: full escalation flow.
Security Requirements: Escalation events logged for audit.
Definition of Done: Escalation detector tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Customer context and history
Description: Implement customer context: retrieve previous conversations and resolutions for returning customers. Surface context to agent dashboard. Include customer tier/account info (configurable mock). Use context in response generation for personalization.
Business Value: Customer context improves resolution quality for repeat customers.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Previous conversations retrieved for known customer. 2. Context summary available in agent dashboard. 3. Context used in response generation prompt. 4. New customer (no history) handled gracefully.
Technical Notes: customer_id from session token. Context: last 3 resolved conversations + account tier (mock). Context injected into response generation prompt as a separate section.
Testing Requirements: Unit: context retrieval with fixtures. Integration: context used in response.
Security Requirements: customer_id from auth context. No PII in structured logs.
Definition of Done: Context tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Feedback and rating collection
Description: Implement: customer rates conversation (1–5 stars + optional comment), agent marks response as good/bad with correction. Store feedback. Analytics: average CSAT score, feedback breakdown by intent.
Business Value: Feedback drives quality improvement and demonstrates value measurement.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Customer can submit rating + comment. 2. Agent can mark response good/bad. 3. Analytics endpoint returns CSAT and feedback counts. 4. Tests cover all feedback types.
Technical Notes: feedback table: conversation_id
Testing Requirements: comment
Security Requirements: role (customer/agent)
Definition of Done: correction. Analytics: computed from feedback table.
column18: Unit: feedback storage. Integration: submit feedback → analytics updated.
column19: Comment content not in structured logs.

Summary: Support analytics dashboard
Description: Build analytics: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns resolution_rate, escalation_rate, avg_csat, avg_response_time, open_conversations. Time-range filter. Frontend analytics page with charts.
Business Value: Analytics demonstrate business value and drive operational decisions.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Analytics endpoint returns correct metrics. 2. Time-range filter works. 3. Frontend displays charts for CSAT, resolution rate, escalation rate. 4. Accessible chart components (ARIA labels).
Technical Notes: Metrics computed with SQL aggregates — no in-memory computation. Charts: Recharts or Chart.js. See docs/api/api-style-guide.md for response format.
Testing Requirements: Unit: analytics SQL queries. Integration: data flow to frontend.
Security Requirements: Analytics data is aggregated — no PII in response.
Definition of Done: Analytics tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Human agent interface and approval workflow
Description: Build agent dashboard: conversation queue, conversation detail with AI draft, approve/edit/send controls, escalation history. Agent edits are tracked as corrections.
Business Value: Agent oversight and approval is the human-in-the-loop control for support quality.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Agent sees all escalated conversations. 2. Agent can view AI draft response. 3. Agent can edit and send. 4. Edits tracked as corrections. 5. Keyboard accessible.
Technical Notes: React + TypeScript. Agent role from JWT. Corrections stored in feedback table with original_response field.
Testing Requirements: Unit: agent UI components. E2E: escalation → agent reviews → sends edited response.
Security Requirements: Agent auth from JWT. No customer PII shown beyond what is needed.
Definition of Done: Agent dashboard tested. E2E test passes. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Customer-facing chat UI
Description: Build embedded chat widget: message input, conversation thread display, escalation request button, rating prompt on resolution. Accessible and mobile-responsive.
Business Value: Chat UI is the customer touchpoint — quality directly impacts customer experience.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Customer can send messages and receive responses. 2. Escalation request button works. 3. Rating prompt appears on resolution. 4. Mobile-responsive. 5. Keyboard accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Technical Notes: Anonymous session token stored in sessionStorage. Polling or SSE for response delivery. TailwindCSS for styling.
Testing Requirements: Unit: chat components. E2E: full customer conversation flow.
Security Requirements: Session token not in localStorage (use sessionStorage or memory).
Definition of Done: Chat UI tested. E2E test passes. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Add project-specific evaluation and regression test harness
Description: Build evaluation: 15 support scenarios (question + expected_resolution + should_escalate). Metrics: resolution_rate, escalation_accuracy, response_relevance (LLM-as-judge), avg_turns_to_resolution. Store baseline.
Business Value: Measured quality justifies AI assistance in customer support.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Eval runner executes on 15 scenarios. 2. Metrics reported per-case and aggregate. 3. Baseline stored. 4. Regression runner shows delta from baseline.
Technical Notes: resolution_rate: % scenarios resolved without escalation. escalation_accuracy: % correct escalation decisions. response_relevance: LLM-as-judge (1-5 scale). See docs/evaluation/evaluation-framework.md.
Testing Requirements: Evaluation: run all scenarios. Per-case: inspectable failures.
Security Requirements: Evaluation scenarios contain no real customer PII.
Definition of Done: Evaluation runs. Baseline stored. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Add observability audit events and operational dashboards
Description: Structured logging, Prometheus metrics (conversations_total, escalations_total, ai_tokens_used_total, response_latency_seconds), audit events for escalation and agent actions, OPERATIONS.md dashboard documentation.
Business Value: Operational visibility before production use.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Structured JSON logs on all requests. 2. /metrics returns expected metrics. 3. Audit events for escalation and agent send. 4. OPERATIONS.md updated.
Technical Notes: Log conversation events without message content. Escalation events include conversation_id and reason.
Testing Requirements: Integration: log format. Metrics: spot-check counters.
Security Requirements: No customer message content in logs.
Definition of Done: Observability tested. OPERATIONS.md updated. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Implement security and privacy controls for project-specific risks
Description: Threat-model P03. Implement and test: prompt injection via customer message, conversation isolation (customer A cannot see customer B's conversation), PII handling (message content not in plain-text logs), escalation accuracy. Complete security gate checklist.
Business Value: Security hardening before release.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Prompt injection test: adversarial message does not hijack system prompt. 2. Conversation isolation test: customer A cannot access customer B's conversation. 3. PII test: message content not in structured logs. 4. Security gate checklist in docs/security/.
Technical Notes: Customer messages in parameterized LLM slot. Conversation access controlled by customer_id from session token. See .kiro/steering/security.md.
Testing Requirements: Security tests: prompt injection, conversation isolation, PII in logs.
Security Requirements: Security checklist signed off. No unmitigated critical findings.
Definition of Done: Security gate signed off. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Add CI/CD containerization and deployment documentation
Description: GitHub Actions CI: lint, type-check, secret scan, pip-audit, tests. Multi-stage Dockerfile. docker-compose.yml. DEPLOYMENT.md with migration steps and rollback.
Business Value: Production readiness.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. CI passes. 2. Dockerfile builds. 3. docker-compose up works. 4. DEPLOYMENT.md complete. 5. pip-audit: no high/critical CVEs.
Technical Notes: Multi-stage Dockerfile. Non-root user. detect-secrets and pip-audit in CI.
Testing Requirements: CI: all steps pass. Docker: image builds.
Security Requirements: detect-secrets and pip-audit in CI.
Definition of Done: CI passing. DEPLOYMENT.md complete. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Deliver integrated demo workflow and release acceptance report
Description: Repeatable demo: customer sends 3 support messages → AI responds with citations → escalation triggered → agent reviews → resolves. Release acceptance report with real test/eval results and known limitations.
Business Value: Demo and report are the Gate G5 evidence package.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Demo runs end-to-end. 2. AI response cites knowledge article. 3. Escalation flow demonstrated. 4. Evaluation results included in report. 5. Human approval obtained.
Technical Notes: Demo script in scripts/demo.py. Report in docs/operations/release-P03-v1.0.md. Real numbers only.
Testing Requirements: E2E: run demo. Report: spot-check citations and escalation.
Security Requirements: No secrets in demo data.
Definition of Done: Demo passes. Report written. Gate G5 approval obtained.
